name: Executive Tables for Exterior Commerce: Collaborative Addressing COVID-19's Impact in Costa Rica
content: Problems and Purpose The initiative was a deliberative exercise between the national government of Costa Rica and the private sector to coordinate actions on emerging challenges in the sector during the COVID-19 pandemic. Convened by the authorities of the Ministry of Foreign Trade, the Foreign Trade Promoter, and the Costa Rican Coalition of Development Initiatives, 10 business chambers held a virtual meeting to identify current and potential impacts on the sector derived from the pandemic. Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection Methods and Tools Used What Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation Influence, Outcomes, and Effects As a result, a joint work mechanism and permanent communication channels were established within the sector.
